name: Share gain
priority: P1 — strategic; share is estimated, gate on EST
problem: Am I growing, and what's driving it?
delivered: SKUs/keywords behind the growth and where to reinvest
calc: share_t vs share_(t-1) % change; attribute delta to SKUs by contribution
narrative: Home Audio share rose to 21.3% (+2.1 pts WoW), driven mostly by SKU-4471 and 'wireless earbuds', both up double digits.
action: Increase ad budget 15% on SKU-4471 and SKU-4480 (Ads API; approve to execute) + create a restock task to protect availability.

name: Share erosion
priority: P1 — high value; precision needs EST
problem: Am I losing ground before it's too late?
delivered: Share dropped + the most likely cause
calc: share % drop >= X; join to concurrent price/OOS/entrant/ad signals to attribute cause
narrative: Home Audio share fell 1.8 pts this week; the drop tracks 3 ASINs going out of stock and TechMaster undercutting 2 more.
action: Open a 'share defense' ticket linking the 5 ASINs (assignee + SLA) + apply a floor-gated repricing rule on the undercut ASINs.

name: Rank change
priority: P2 — low value unless tied to revenue
problem: Did I move up or down the category ranking?
delivered: Passed, or was passed by, a named competitor
calc: category_rank crossing vs competitor set
narrative: You slipped from #3 to #4 in Portable Speakers; EliteGadgets overtook you after a 9% price cut across 12 SKUs.
action: Create a tracked rank-recovery ticket + set heightened monitoring on EliteGadgets.

name: Competitor share surge
problem: Is a rival taking my market?
delivered: Rival's share jumped + the tactic behind it
calc: competitor share % jump > z; correlate to their price/assortment/ad moves
narrative: TechMaster's share jumped 3.4 pts in 10 days, correlating with a category-wide coupon push.
action: Open a counter-strategy ticket + add TechMaster's promo SKUs to your price-match watchlist.

name: Unit-vs-revenue divergence
problem: Am I buying share by giving away margin?
delivered: Units up but revenue/margin share down = price erosion
calc: unit_share trend vs revenue_share trend divergence; ASP trend
narrative: Unit share is up but revenue share is down 1.2 pts: ASP slipped 6% while volume rose, eroding margin.
action: Raise price on the 4 highest-volume SKUs toward the market band (reprice, floor-gated; approve to execute).

name: Subcategory imbalance
problem: Where am I over- or under-indexed?
delivered: Strong vs weak subcategories to reallocate across
calc: per-subcat share vs portfolio average
narrative: You're #2 in Earbuds (24%) but #7 in Headphones (8%), and Headphones carries higher margin.
action: Create a reallocation ticket + draft an ad-budget shift toward Headphones for approval (Ads API).

name: Share-at-risk
problem: Is my lead about to be contested?
delivered: Leading but the gap to #2 is narrowing
calc: gap_to_rank2 slope < 0 and gap < threshold
narrative: You lead Chargers at 19% but the gap to #2 has halved in 6 weeks; ValueMart is closing fast.
action: Set a defensive match-to-floor repricing rule on your top 3 Charger ASINs + add ValueMart to watchlist.

name: Competitor price drop
priority: P0 — daily money, margin-gated, hero demo
problem: Am I being undercut right now?
delivered: Undercut on a shared listing + margin-aware match-or-hold
calc: comp_price drop %; price_delta = our-comp; floor = landed_cost+fees; rec_price = max(comp, floor); margin_at_match
narrative: TechMaster dropped Wireless Earbuds to $42.99 (-12%), undercutting your $48.90 and taking the Buy Box.
action: Reprice to $43.50; your floor is $41.20 so the match stays profitable (reprice, floor-gated; approve to execute).
rds_fields: our_price, comp_price, price_delta, pct_change, breakeven_floor, rec_price, margin_at_match, buybox_status

name: Competitor price increase
priority: P0 — margin upside, cheap to build
problem: Can I raise price and capture margin?
delivered: Rival raised price = headroom for us
calc: comp_price rise %; headroom = comp-our; projected margin gain
narrative: EliteGadgets raised the USB-C Hub to $34.99; you're at $29.99 with room to follow.
action: Raise price to $32.99 to capture ~$3/unit while staying below them (reprice, floor-gated; approve).

name: Price-band gap
problem: Am I mispriced vs the market band?
delivered: Our delta vs the market band is too wide
calc: our_price vs band (min/median/max of offers); delta beyond band
narrative: Your Bluetooth Speaker at $58.90 sits 14% above the market median of $51.50, likely costing you the Buy Box.
action: Reprice to $52.40 (band-aligned, floor $47.10) (reprice, floor-gated; approve).

name: Price-war detection
problem: Am I in a race to the bottom?
delivered: Rapid back-and-forth cuts = hold/exit, don't chase
calc: count price changes in window > z; downward trend across N sellers
narrative: Your Charger SKU saw 11 price changes in 48h across 3 sellers, trending toward the floor.
action: Pause auto-reprice and set a floor-protect rule on this SKU to stop the race to the bottom (safety rule; one-click).

name: Featured-offer eligibility breach
priority: P0 — direct Buy-Box cause, SP-API native
problem: Why did I lose the Buy Box on price?
delivered: Our price exceeds the featured-offer expected price
calc: our_price > FOEP; gap; margin at FOEP
narrative: You lost the Buy Box on the Pet Bed: your $64.20 exceeds the featured-offer price of $61.80.
action: Reprice to $61.50 to regain eligibility (floor $58.00) (reprice, floor-gated; approve).

name: Effective-price undercut
priority: P1 — real undercut hidden from list price
problem: Am I undercut after coupons I can't see in list price?
delivered: Rival's after-coupon price beats us
calc: comp_effective = list - coupon/promo; vs our_effective
narrative: SmartBuy's list price matches yours, but a 15% coupon makes their effective price $34.00 vs your $39.99.
action: Match effective price via reprice to $34.50 (floor $31.00), or draft a matching coupon for approval (reprice, floor-gated).

name: Price-volatility spike
priority: P2 — context signal, low action value
problem: Is competitor pricing unstable (clearance/war signal)?
delivered: Erratic competitor pricing flagged
calc: stdev / z of comp price over window
narrative: Competitor pricing on your Speaker SKU is unusually erratic (std dev 3x normal), likely a repricer war or clearance.
action: Add the SKU to a volatility watchlist and hold your price for 72h (monitoring rule; one-click).

name: White-space gap
priority: P1 — growth driver; Keepa product finder
problem: What am I not selling that I should?
delivered: A segment rivals cover and we don't, sized for launch
calc: competitor SKU set - our SKU set within category; size demand
narrative: Competitors cover 'mesh wifi extenders' (est. $1.2M/yr) where you have no SKU.
action: Create a tracked launch-opportunity ticket with the sizing + set monitoring on the segment's pricing.

name: New competitor SKU

narrative: EliteGadgets added 47 SKUs in Audio this month (+18%), expanding into your strongest subcategory.

name: Variation/bundle gap

name: Price-tier gap

narrative: You're absent from the $80+ premium tier in Speakers, which holds 22% of category revenue.

name: Demand surge
priority: P0 — prevents lost sales; margin upside

name: Demand decline

narrative: Your Space Heater demand has fallen 4 weeks running; you're carrying 140 days of cover.

name: Competitor velocity spike

delivered: A rival SKU's estimated sales jumped

narrative: TechMaster's earbud is selling ~2x its norm this week, coinciding with a sponsored push.

name: Seasonality onset
priority: P1 — needs history; high planning value
problem: Is a seasonal ramp starting - am I ready?
delivered: A known seasonal pattern is beginning
calc: YoY seasonal index inflection
narrative: Your Garden Hose is entering its seasonal ramp (history shows +120% over 6 weeks); lead time is 4 weeks.
action: Create a pre-season restock task now + schedule an ad-budget increase for the ramp (Ads API; approve).

name: Demand-supply mismatch
priority: P0 — capture window, margin upside, hero
problem: Is there demand nobody can fulfill right now?
delivered: High demand + category-wide low stock = capture window
calc: demand high AND in-stock competitor offers low
narrative: Demand for the Air Purifier is high and 3 of 4 competitors are out of stock; a capture window is open.
action: Raise price to capture (reprice, floor-gated) + increase ad budget 25% (Ads API) and create a restock task.

name: BSR threshold crossing
problem: Did I cross a meaningful rank tier (badge/visibility)?
delivered: BSR crossed into/out of a meaningful tier
calc: BSR crosses tier boundary
narrative: Your Yoga Mat just broke into the category top 100, unlocking badge visibility.

name: Category early-warning
problem: Is my whole category declining?
delivered: Sustained category-level demand decline
calc: category demand slope < 0 sustained
narrative: Fitness Tracker category demand has declined 8 weeks straight, a structural softening rather than a blip.
action: Create a category harvest/exit planning ticket + set monitoring on category demand.

name: Scale play
priority: P0 — pure margin wedge; the 8.6x demo moment
problem: Where's found money I'm under-investing?
delivered: High-ROAS / high-margin SKU under-invested = scale it
calc: M-ROAS or margin high AND ad budget/share low; compute headroom
narrative: Your Pet Bed sponsored ads return 8.6x M-ROAS but get only 4% of your ad budget; it's under-funded.
action: Increase ad budget 50% on the Pet Bed campaign (Ads API; approve to execute) + create a restock task to protect availability.

name: Competitor weakness
problem: Where is the leader soft so I can attack?
delivered: Leader weak in a subcat (content/reviews/OOS)
calc: leader signals below threshold in subcat
narrative: The category leader is soft in 'gaming headsets', with thin content and a 3.6 rating; you're well-positioned.
action: Create an attack ticket + draft a sponsored campaign targeting the subcategory for approval (Ads API).

name: Keyword opportunity
problem: What high-volume term could I win?
delivered: High-volume keyword we rank poorly but could win
calc: keyword volume high, our rank low, winnability score
narrative: 'noise cancelling earbuds' gets ~40k searches/mo; you rank organically but have no ad presence.
action: Add the keyword to your sponsored campaign with a starting bid + draft listing-copy inclusion (Ads API + Listings API; approve).

name: Pricing headroom
problem: Am I leaving margin on the table?
delivered: Underpriced + inelastic demand = test an increase
calc: demand stable across prior price moves; gap to market
narrative: Your Desk Lamp held volume through two prior price increases; demand looks inelastic and you're 9% under market.
action: Raise price to $27.99 to capture margin (reprice, floor-gated; approve).

name: Marketplace expansion
problem: Where am I winning that I should replicate elsewhere?
delivered: Strong on one channel, absent on another
calc: SKU performance channel A vs absence channel B
narrative: Your Backpack is a top Amazon seller but isn't listed on eBay, where 2 competitors clear ~400/mo.
action: Create a channel-expansion initiative ticket + set cross-channel price monitoring.

name: OOS capture window
problem: A rival is out of stock - can I grab demand now?
delivered: Competitor OOS on a contested listing
calc: competitor offer OOS AND shared/contested ASIN
narrative: SmartBuy is out of stock on a contested Tripod; redirected demand is up for grabs for ~48h.
action: Increase bids/budget on the contested ASIN (Ads API) + reprice to capture (floor-gated; approve).

name: Preemptive defense
problem: What cheap move now avoids an expensive fight later?
delivered: A fast-growing threat that's cheap to blunt now
calc: threat growth slope high, base low; cost-to-defend low
narrative: A small rival's Stylus is growing 30%/mo off a low base; blunting it now is cheap.
action: Create a preemptive-defense ticket + set a match-to-floor rule on your competing SKU.

name: Buy Box lost
problem: I lost the Buy Box - why, and how do I get it back?
delivered: Buy Box loss + cause + margin-aware fix
calc: buybox_owner != us (transition); diagnose price/stock/fulfillment/metrics; rec_price = max(winning_price, floor)
narrative: You lost the Buy Box on the USB-C Hub to a $27.99 offer; your $29.99 is above it but your floor is $25.50.
action: Reprice to $27.90 to reclaim the Buy Box profitably (reprice, floor-gated; approve to execute).
rds_fields: buybox_owner, winning_price, our_price, floor, rec_price, cause

name: Buy Box suppressed
problem: Nobody has the Buy Box - why?
delivered: Buy Box suppressed on the ASIN
calc: no featured offer present on ASIN
narrative: No seller holds the Buy Box on your Speaker; your $58.90 is above Amazon's reference price.
action: Reprice toward the reference price to restore the Buy Box (reprice, floor-gated; approve).

name: Buy Box flip frequency

name: Unauthorized seller / hijacker

problem: Is someone hijacking my listing?
delivered: An unexpected seller is on our listing
calc: offer seller_id not in authorized set on our ASIN
narrative: An unrecognized seller appeared on your branded Lamp listing at a suspiciously low price.
action: Generate and submit an unauthorized-seller report + add the seller to your enforcement watchlist (Brand Registry case; approve to submit).

name: Counterfeit / condition-mismatch
problem: Is a bad offer damaging my listing?
delivered: A suspicious condition/price offer on our ASIN
calc: condition mismatch or price far below floor on our ASIN
narrative: A 'new' offer on your listing is priced 60% below your floor, a counterfeit-risk pattern.
action: Submit a counterfeit/IP report via Brand Registry + flag the offer for review (approve to submit).

name: Seller-count change
problem: Is competition on my listing intensifying?
delivered: Seller count changed on a shared ASIN

narrative: Offers on your Cable ASIN jumped from 3 to 8 sellers this week; competition is intensifying.

delivered: A competitor FBM<->FBA change
calc: competitor offer fulfillment channel change
narrative: A competitor on your shared ASIN switched from FBM to FBA, gaining Prime and Buy Box weight.
action: Add to watchlist + create an assessment ticket; draft a repricing response for approval.

name: Organic rank drop

delivered: Organic rank drop on a priority keyword

narrative: You fell from position 4 to 11 for 'wireless charger' over 5 days.

name: Share-of-voice loss

delivered: Share-of-voice loss, split paid vs organic

narrative: Your share of voice on 'bluetooth speaker' fell from 12% to 7%, mostly on the paid side.
action: Draft an ad-budget increase on the term for approval + create a monitoring rule (Ads API).

name: Competitor ranking surge
problem: Who's climbing on my keywords?
delivered: A rival ranking surge on our terms
calc: competitor rank improvement on shared keyword > z
narrative: TechMaster climbed from position 8 to 2 on your core keyword 'earbuds'.
action: Add the keyword to a rank-watch + draft a sponsored counter for approval (Ads API).

name: Keyword gap
problem: What terms should I rank for but don't?
delivered: Relevant keywords with no presence
calc: competitor-ranked keywords - our-ranked; relevance filter
narrative: Competitors rank for 'usb c fast charger' (high volume) where you have no presence.
action: Add the keyword to your sponsored campaign + draft listing-copy inclusion for approval (Ads API + Listings API).

name: Sponsored-share shift
problem: Is a rival outspending me on my keywords?
delivered: A rival increased paid presence on our keywords
calc: competitor sponsored placement frequency POP up
narrative: A rival now appears in sponsored slots on 6 of your top 10 keywords, up from 1.
action: Draft a defensive bid increase on the contested keywords for approval (Ads API) + add to watchlist.

name: Competitor content upgrade
problem: Did a rival improve their listing past mine?
delivered: Competitor content upgrade (title/images/A+/video)
calc: comp content attributes changed/added vs snapshot
narrative: EliteGadgets added video and a 7-image gallery to a competing listing; yours has 3 images and no video.

name: Content gap vs norms
problem: Is my listing below category standard?
delivered: Our content below category norms

action: Draft the missing title/bullets/keywords and queue a listing update for approval (Listings API).

delivered: An unexpected change to our own listing
calc: our listing attribute/variation changed unexpectedly
narrative: Your Lamp listing's title and main image changed unexpectedly 2 days ago.

name: Competitor content degradation
problem: Is a rival's listing slipping (chance to outshine)?
delivered: Competitor content degraded
calc: comp content removed/worse vs snapshot
narrative: A competitor's top listing lost its A+ content and dropped to 2 images, a chance to outshine.
action: Create an opportunity ticket + draft an enhanced-content update for your competing SKU (Listings API).

name: Rating drop
problem: Is my (or a rival's) rating moving?
delivered: Rating threshold crossing, ours or a rival's
calc: avg rating POP drop / crosses threshold
narrative: Your Blender's rating slipped from 4.4 to 4.1 this month, crossing below the 4.2 buy-threshold.
action: Open a quality task + enable automated review requests on recent orders (SP-API Solicitations; approve).

name: Negative-review spike
priority: P2 — high value but needs review text
problem: Is a quality problem emerging on my SKU?
delivered: Negative review surge on our listing
calc: negative review rate > z
narrative: Negative reviews on your Kettle are up 3x this week, clustering on 'leaks'.
action: Open an urgent quality ticket + pause ads on the SKU to limit exposure (Ads API) and draft a CS response template.

problem: What do rivals' customers hate (so I can differentiate)?
delivered: Recurring complaint themes in rival reviews
calc: cluster negative themes in competitor reviews
narrative: The top complaint across TechMaster's earbud reviews is 'poor battery', a differentiation angle for you.
action: Create a messaging-brief task + draft listing copy emphasizing your battery life for approval (Listings API).

name: Review-velocity gap
problem: Are rivals gaining reviews faster than me?
delivered: Review accumulation gap vs competitors
calc: review count slope us vs competitor
narrative: Competitors are gaining reviews ~2x faster than you on the contested Speaker.

narrative: SmartBuy launched a 20% coupon on a competing Charger, dropping their effective price to $19.99 vs your $24.99.

delivered: A rival lightning/best deal detected

narrative: EliteGadgets is running a Lightning Deal on a competing Speaker for the next 6 hours.

problem: Should I join Prime Day / BFCM where rivals are?
delivered: Event participation gap vs competitors

narrative: 3 of your top competitors are enrolled in next month's Prime Day in your category; you're not.

delivered: A recurring promo cadence detected

narrative: TechMaster runs a coupon on this SKU the first week of every month; the next is likely in 9 days.

problem: Is someone hitting me on price + assortment + ads at once?
delivered: A multi-vector attack from one competitor
calc: -2 concurrent threat signals from same competitor in window
narrative: TechMaster hit you on 3 fronts this week: undercut 6 ASINs, added 12 SKUs, and doubled sponsored presence.
action: Open a high-priority strategic-response ticket (assignee + SLA) + set heightened monitoring on TechMaster.

name: Coordinated multi-listing undercut
problem: Am I being undercut across many SKUs at once?
delivered: A portfolio-level undercut by one competitor
calc: count of our ASINs undercut by same competitor > N
narrative: One seller undercut 9 of your ASINs simultaneously, putting ~$12K of monthly margin at risk.

name: Category-wide MAP erosion
problem: Is my brand's price floor collapsing across sellers?
delivered: Widespread MAP violations across sellers/ASINs
calc: count of offers below MAP across sellers/ASINs
narrative: 11 sellers are listing your brand below MAP across 7 ASINs.
action: Generate and send MAP-violation notices to the offenders + open an enforcement case (approve to send).

name: Listing suppression / availability anomaly
problem: Did one of my listings break or get suppressed?
delivered: Our own listing health anomaly
calc: our ASIN suppressed/unavailable unexpectedly
narrative: Your best-selling Lamp listing went unavailable overnight, likely a suppressed-Buy-Box / health issue.
action: Open a listing-health case + if price-driven, reprice to restore eligibility (reprice, floor-gated; approve).

name: Revenue leak from returns
problem: Which SKUs lose money once returns, refunds and promos are netted out?
delivered: SKUs whose net revenue has gone negative, with the driver isolated
calc: [R5 · Returns Spike] Net Revenue (SKU) = Gross Revenue − Returns − Refunds − Promotions. Flags when: Net Revenue per SKU < 0 over trailing 7 days.
narrative: SKU-2231 net revenue went negative (−₹180/unit) over the last 7 days; returns (14%) are the main driver, not price.
action: Fix listing accuracy to cut returns, raise price to cover return cost, or pause the SKU (Listings / repricing rule).
rds_fields: net_revenue, gross_revenue, returns_value, refunds_value, promo_value, net_margin

name: Cross-channel price gap risk
problem: Are my own prices drifting apart across channels in a way that risks listings?
delivered: Same-SKU price gap across channels that has persisted beyond tolerance
calc: [R4 · Parity Drift] Parity Gap % = (Channel A Price − Channel B Price) ÷ Channel A Price × 100. Flags when: Gap > 10% on the same SKU persisted > 24 hours.
narrative: SKU-4471 is 13% cheaper on Shopify than Amazon and has been for 2 days — risks the Amazon Buy Box and MAP.
action: Close the gap on high-risk SKUs, or set an intentional-pricing exception to stop flagging (repricing rule).

name: Revenue retention declining
problem: Is the gap between gross and net revenue widening over time?
delivered: Net-revenue retention trend and the largest contributor to the decline
calc: [R5 · Returns Spike] Net Revenue = Gross − Returns − Refunds − Promotions. Gap Trend = Gross growth% − Net growth% over rolling 14 days. Flags when: Gap trend > 1.5 pts over rolling 14 days.
narrative: Net revenue is growing 2.3 pts slower than gross over the last 14 days — refunds are the biggest contributor.
action: Identify whether returns, refunds or discounts dominate and fix the largest contributor first (monitoring + reprice).

name: Fast mover running low on cover
problem: Which fast-selling SKUs are about to run out of stock?
delivered: SKUs with a genuine velocity surge (not price/promo-driven) to stock & scale
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk] Units/Day = Total Units ÷ Days. Velocity Ratio = Units/Day (this wk) ÷ Units/Day (prior wk). Flags when: Velocity Ratio ≥ 3× with price change < 1% and no active promotion.
narrative: SKU-8890 is selling 3.4× last week's rate with no price or promo change — protect stock and lean in before it fades.
action: Ensure full stock and increase ad spend on these SKUs before momentum fades (restock task + Ads action).

name: Silent volume erosion
problem: Are units quietly falling without a price or promo reason?
delivered: Unexplained WoW unit decline, with Buy Box checked as the first cause
calc: [R1 · Buy Box Take] Unit Decline % = (Units wk − Units prior wk) ÷ Units prior wk × 100. BB% = Sessions with Buy Box ÷ Total Sessions × 100. Flags when: Unit decline > 15% WoW with price change < 1% and no promotion ending.
narrative: SKU-1180 units fell 18% WoW with no price or promo change — Buy Box share dropped to 61%, the likely cause.
action: Check Buy Box on these SKUs first; if Buy Box is held, trigger a listing-quality review (ticket).

name: Channel diversification accelerating
problem: Is one channel out-growing the other fast enough to need price oversight?
delivered: Channel mix shift + the parity risk it creates as the faster channel scales
calc: [R4 · Parity Drift] Channel Mix % = Channel Rev ÷ Total Rev. Channel Growth % = (Channel Rev mo − prior mo) ÷ prior mo. AOV/channel = Channel Rev ÷ Channel Orders. Flags when: faster channel growth ≥ 2× the other over rolling 30 days.
narrative: Shopify is growing 2.4× faster than Amazon this month and is now 31% of revenue — watch parity as it scales.
action: Monitor pricing across both channels; a persistent gap as the faster channel scales puts the other at risk (monitoring).

name: Top sellers thinning to low cover
problem: How exposed am I to stocking out on my key SKUs?
delivered: Revenue concentration in a few SKUs + the resulting stockout/key-man risk
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk] Concentration = Top-N SKU Revenue ÷ Total Revenue (and/or HHI). Flags when: top SKUs exceed a concentration threshold (e.g. top 5 > 60% of revenue).
narrative: Your top 5 SKUs are 64% of revenue; a stockout on SKU-4471 alone would hit ~22% of sales.
action: Reprice, bundle, or remove dormant SKUs; ensure the lead SKU never risks a stockout (restock task + monitoring).

name: Discounts becoming permanent
problem: Are 'temporary' discounts quietly becoming the everyday price?
delivered: SKUs where promo frequency/depth has normalised into a permanent markdown
calc: [R2 · Margin Compression] Promo Frequency = Days on promo ÷ Days in period. Effective Discount = 1 − (Net ASP ÷ List Price). Flags when: promo frequency or effective discount trends up and stays elevated.
narrative: SKU-3320 has been discounted 22 of the last 30 days; the 'sale' price is now effectively the list price.
action: Reset the everyday price or break the promo cadence; treat the discount as structural margin loss (repricing rule).

name: Margin quietly shrinking
problem: Is my contribution margin eroding even while revenue looks fine?
delivered: Margin compression trend with the cost driver (fees, ads, returns, COGS) isolated
calc: [R2 · Margin Compression] Contribution Margin % = (Net Revenue − COGS − Fees − Ad Cost) ÷ Net Revenue. Flags when: CM% declines beyond tolerance over a rolling window.
narrative: Contribution margin slipped from 28% to 24% over 3 weeks; rising FBA fees, not price, are the driver.
action: Identify the cost driver and act on the largest (floor-gated reprice / fee review / ad trim).

name: Ad spend eroding profit
problem: Is advertising eating the margin it's supposed to grow?
delivered: SKUs/campaigns where ad cost has pushed net margin below target
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] TACoS = Ad Spend ÷ Total Revenue. Net Margin after Ads = CM% − TACoS. Flags when: TACoS above threshold or net-margin-after-ads < target.
narrative: SKU-2231's TACoS hit 19% and pushed net margin to 3%; the campaign is spending profit, not building it.
action: Cut bid/budget or pause the offending campaign; reallocate to profitable SKUs (Ads action).

name: Cross-channel price gap
problem: Same-SKU price parity drift across channels (margin lens).
delivered: Same-SKU cross-channel gap beyond tolerance
calc: [R4 · Price Parity Drift] Parity Gap % = (Channel A − Channel B) ÷ Channel A × 100. Flags when: Gap > 10% on the same SKU.
narrative: (See #2.) Same parity-drift signal surfaced under the Margin page.
action: Close the gap or set an intentional-pricing exception (repricing rule).

name: SKUs destroying profit
problem: Which SKUs lose money on every unit once all costs are loaded?
delivered: Ranked list of structurally unprofitable SKUs (negative loaded margin)
calc: [R2 · Margin Compression] Loaded Unit Margin = Net ASP − COGS − Fees − Allocated Ad − Return Cost. Flags when: Loaded Unit Margin < 0.
narrative: 6 SKUs are below breakeven on every unit, bleeding ~₹84k/month combined; SKU-1180 is the worst.
action: Reprice to the floor or discontinue the structurally unprofitable SKUs (floor-gated reprice / delist).
rds_fields: loaded_unit_margin, cogs, fees, allocated_ad, return_cost, monthly_bleed

name: Returns wiping out margin
problem: Where are returns turning a profitable SKU into a loss (margin lens)?
delivered: SKUs where return cost erases contribution margin
calc: [R5 · Returns Spike] Return-Adjusted Margin = CM − (Return Rate × Return Cost per Unit). Flags when: return-adjusted margin < target or return rate spikes.
narrative: SKU-2231's 14% return rate cuts its real margin from 26% to 4% once return handling is loaded in.
action: Fix the return root cause or price to absorb return cost (listing fix / reprice).

name: Buy Box lost — margin at risk
problem: Did I lose the Buy Box, and how much margin is exposed?
delivered: Buy Box loss event with the revenue/margin at stake quantified
calc: [R1 · Buy Box Loss] BB% = Sessions with Buy Box ÷ Total Sessions. Flags when: BB% crosses below threshold (e.g. < 80%) on a revenue SKU.
narrative: Buy Box on SKU-4471 dropped to 58%, putting ~₹120k of monthly revenue at risk.
action: Apply a floor-gated repricing rule to regain the Buy Box, or investigate the cause (repricing rule / ticket).

name: Pricing action reversed
problem: Did an automated price change get rolled back, and why?
delivered: Auto-rollback events with the trigger (floor breach / parity / error) named
calc: [R7 · Auto-Rollback] Detect price-state reversal within a short window vs the floor/parity guardrails. Flags when: an automated price change is reverted by a guardrail.
narrative: An auto-reprice on SKU-3320 was rolled back within 10 min — it breached the margin floor.
action: Review the repricing rule configuration that triggered the rollback (governance / monitoring).

name: Settlement short-paid
problem: Did Amazon pay me less than the order economics imply?
delivered: Settlements where deposited amount is below expected, with the gap quantified
calc: [R8 · Settlement Anomaly] Expected Settlement = Σ(order revenue − expected fees). Variance = Actual Deposit − Expected. Flags when: |variance| beyond tolerance (under-payment).
narrative: Last settlement was ₹38k below expected — overcharged FBA fees on 47 orders look like the cause.
action: Open a reconciliation / FBA reimbursement case for the shortfall (case / report).

name: Stockout risk detected
problem: Which SKUs will run out before resupply, costing sales and rank?
delivered: SKUs whose days-of-cover fall below lead time, ranked by revenue at risk
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk] Days of Cover = Stock on Hand ÷ Units per Day. Flags when: Days of Cover < Lead Time (+ safety buffer).
narrative: SKU-8890 has 6 days of cover against a 14-day lead time — a stockout will cost ~₹90k and rank.
action: Create a restock/expedite task before cover runs out (restock task).

name: Excess inventory identified
problem: Where is cash trapped in stock that won't sell through in time?
delivered: SKUs with days-of-cover far above target, ranked by tied-up cash
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk] Days of Cover = Stock ÷ Units/Day. Excess = Stock above (target DOC × Units/Day). Flags when: Days of Cover >> target (e.g. > 120 days).
narrative: SKU-3320 holds 180 days of cover; ~₹140k of cash and rising FBA storage fees are tied up.
action: Run a clearance promo, liquidate, or pause replenishment POs (Ads/deal + restock task).

name: Dead inventory detected
problem: Which stock hasn't moved at all and is just accruing fees?
delivered: Zero/near-zero velocity SKUs with age and carrying cost
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk + R8 · Settlement Anomaly] Aging = Days since last sale; Carrying Cost = storage fee × age. Flags when: zero sales over N days AND aged stock on hand.
narrative: SKU-7710 hasn't sold in 95 days; 220 units are accruing long-term storage fees.
action: Create a removal or liquidation order to stop the fee bleed (restock/removal task).

name: Overstock due to demand drop
problem: Where has falling demand turned healthy stock into overstock?
delivered: SKUs where a demand decline pushed cover above target
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk] Velocity trend (declining) × Days of Cover. Flags when: velocity falling AND days of cover rising past target.
narrative: SKU-1180 demand fell 30% and cover jumped to 150 days — it is now overstock, not buffer.
action: Mark down or pause replenishment; align POs to the new demand (reprice / restock task).

name: Slow-moving inventory
problem: Which SKUs sell too slowly to justify the shelf space?
delivered: Low-velocity SKUs ranked by sell-through and cash efficiency
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk + R1 · Buy Box Take] Sell-through = Units sold ÷ Avg stock. Flags when: sell-through below threshold over the period.
narrative: SKU-7710 sells through 8% of stock per month — capital would work harder elsewhere.
action: Promote, bundle, or exit slow movers; check Buy Box as a cause first (deal / reprice / ticket).

name: Ad budget anomaly — spend spike
problem: Did a campaign's spend jump abnormally versus its own baseline?
delivered: Campaigns spending far above their normal daily run-rate
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] z = (Daily Spend − mean) ÷ stdev over trailing window. Flags when: z above threshold (abnormal spend spike).
narrative: Campaign 'Speakers-Exact' spent 3.1σ above its 30-day norm yesterday with flat sales.
action: Investigate and cap the budget if ROAS doesn't justify the spike (Ads action).

name: Ad budget anomaly (duplicate)
problem: Same R6 ad-spend anomaly signal (repeated entry).
delivered: Same as #22
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] Same definition as #22.
action: Investigate / cap budget (Ads action).

name: Ad budget anomaly (duplicate)
problem: Same R6 ad-spend anomaly signal (repeated entry).
delivered: Same as #22
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] Same definition as #22.
action: Investigate / cap budget (Ads action).

name: Margin-killer campaign running unchecked
problem: Which campaign is unprofitable once true margin is loaded in?
delivered: Campaigns whose ACoS exceeds the SKU's contribution margin
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] Profit-Breakeven ACoS = CM%. Flags when: campaign ACoS > breakeven ACoS (spending below profitability).
narrative: Campaign 'Earbuds-Broad' runs at 41% ACoS against a 30% breakeven — every click loses money.
action: Restructure or pause the campaign; shift budget to profitable terms (Ads action).

name: TACoS trending up — 7-day pattern
problem: Is total ad cost of sales creeping up across the account?
delivered: Account/SKU TACoS uptrend signalling declining organic strength or overspend
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] TACoS = Ad Spend ÷ Total Revenue; fit slope over trailing 7 days. Flags when: TACoS slope rising for 7 consecutive days.
narrative: Account TACoS has risen 7 days straight from 9% to 13% — paid is propping up softening organic.
action: Audit campaigns and shore up organic; cap the trend before it sets a new baseline (Ads action / monitoring).

name: Cash locked in inventory
problem: How much working capital is frozen in stock right now?
delivered: Total and per-SKU cash tied in inventory, with the worst offenders
calc: [R3 · Stockout Risk] Inventory Cash = Σ(units × unit cost); Days of Cover gates 'excess'. Flags when: tied-up cash or excess-cover exceeds threshold.
narrative: ₹2.1M of working capital is in inventory; ~₹430k of that is excess cover on 9 SKUs.
action: Liquidate or mark down the excess to free cash; align POs to turn (deal / restock task).

name: Margin compression impact on cash
problem: How is the margin squeeze translating into lost cash flow?
delivered: Cash-flow effect of declining contribution margin over the period
calc: [R2 · Margin Compression] Cash Impact = Δ CM% × Revenue over period. Flags when: margin decline produces material cash erosion.
narrative: The 4-pt margin slip equals ~₹260k less cash this quarter at current revenue.
action: Fix the underlying margin driver (fees/ads/price) to restore cash (reprice / cost action).

name: Settlement shortfall alert
problem: Same R8 settlement under-payment signal (cash lens).
delivered: Same as #16
calc: [R8 · Settlement Anomaly] Same definition as #16 (expected vs actual deposit variance).
action: Open a reconciliation / reimbursement case (case / report).

name: Ad spend cash burn
problem: Same R6 ad-overspend signal (cash lens).
delivered: Same as #10
calc: [R6 · Ad Budget Anomaly] Same definition as #10 (TACoS / net margin after ads), framed as cash burn.
action: Cut/pause unprofitable spend to stop the cash burn (Ads action).

name: Inventory ROI deterioration
problem: Is the return on inventory capital getting worse?
delivered: SKUs where margin × turn (GMROI) is declining, ranked
calc: [R2 · Margin Compression + R3 · Stockout Risk] GMROI = Gross Margin ₹ ÷ Avg Inventory Cost; trend it. Flags when: GMROI trends down past threshold.
narrative: GMROI on the home-audio line fell from 3.1 to 2.2 as margin thinned and stock built up.
action: Reprice or liquidate to restore capital efficiency; reallocate to higher-ROI SKUs (reprice / restock task).
